aiVerification.summary: Draft is not safe because changed-factor grouping and several outcomes are materially misparsed.
issues: Changed factor wrongly narrows test lot to Box 4 and conflicts with Box 1 subgroup.
Boxes 1/4/7 and line C2/E2 should be preserved as subgroup keys, not primary factors.
Report title row is incorrectly treated as a measurement outcome.
Function, separate VP/CD, dyne, and tension results are mixed under unclear metrics.
Tension spec is available but not carried into parsed measurements.
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor as Normal vs test CD lot IR250410013 size 490k, with boxes and lines as subgroups.
Remove the bogus title-derived measurement outcome.
Separate outcome domains for dyne, tension, VP/CD separation, and function while keeping one validation context.
Reparse Report result rows with correct input, OK, NG, total NG, and NG-rate columns.
Carry tension spec 1.2 kgf and cite the tension header plus each measurement row.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are not sufficient because grouping and metric interpretation are incorrect.
